summary.text: Greg Sharpe is a Republican state representative from Missouri House District 4, which he has represented since 2019, and is the Republican candidate for Missouri Senate District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Greg Sharpe is not running for re-election to House District 4 in 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Budget Committee and the Judiciary Committee, and in 2021-2022 he was vice chair of the Rural Community Development Committee.
